title: pilosella euchaetia subsp. longa
intro: Pilosella euchaetia subsp. longa, commonly known as False Salsify, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella euchaetia subsp. longa include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
